description: This file declares functions related to loading and freeing plugins in the bbfdm system, including dynamic shared object (dotso) plugins and external plugins. It appears to be a header file defining the interface for plugin management.

methods.name: bbfdm_load_internal_plugin
methods.description: Loads an internal plugin for the bbfdm context.

methods.name: bbfdm_load_external_plugin
methods.description: Loads an external plugin given a library handle.

methods.name: bbfdm_load_dotso_plugin
methods.description: Loads a plugin from a shared object file specified by the file path.

methods.name: bbfdm_free_dotso_plugin
methods.description: Frees a previously loaded dotso plugin.
